text: The engineer’s deposition is inadmissible because, although it is former testimony, the company’s motive in the wrongful-termination case (defending its firing of the engineer) differs from its motive in the pilot’s products-liability case (disputing aircraft defects), so it lacks the required similar motive for cross-examination. The statement is also not an opposing-party admission because the engineer was not authorized to speak for the company on safety reports. CONFIDENCE: 90
